text:
Ana M: Quick preflight — final checklist for tomorrow's Launchpad demo? Need owners for registration page copy, Zoom cloud recording + SRT, breakout room assignment, post-event clip uploads to GCS, and HubSpot lead routing. Also privacy/consent language for EU regs. @Chris P @Mason L please confirm.

Chris P: I can take registration page copy + GA tags. Draft ready, will post in drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/launchpad-copy :thumbsup: 

Mason L: I'll own Zoom setup and cloud recordings. Quick Q: do we want separate cloud recording per breakout? That's heavier. 

Ana M: Ideally yes for editing, but file size and transcription time might be an issue. If we can't, at least record main session + breakout local recording for panelists. 

Dana R: I'll handle post-event clip uploads and HubSpot mapping. What field do we want for 'session track'? need a property name. 

Mason L: use 'event_track' (string) — I'll add as custom field in the Zap. 

Dana R: ok. Also, for EU attendees, need explicit consent checkbox on registration (GDPR). Suggested copy: 'I consent to Redwood Inference contacting me about product updates and event replays.' 

Ana M: Approved. Add link to privacy policy. 

Chris P: Registration page checklist: title, short blurb, speakers, agenda bullets, timezone selector, confirmation email with recording opt-in link. I'll post final copy by EOD. 

Mason L: Zoom settings I will configure: Cloud recording on (MP4 + audio transcript), auto-record, enable alternative hosts, waiting room enabled, breakout rooms pre-assign (csv), co-hosts = @Mason L @Dana R, record separate audio files = off. Will also toggle 'Only authenticated users can join' = off for public event? thoughts. 

Ana M: Public event, so keep auth off. Enable passcode in registration to prevent random joins. 

Mason L: noted. For transcript: Zoom's captions are meh. Plan: enable auto-transcript, and upload SRT from Rev after event for final captions. Setting for auto-transcript ON. 

Dana R: For uploads, I'll make a GCS folder naming scheme: gs://marketing/events/launchpad-2026/20260301_live-session. Share perms with video-editor-team@redwood.com 

ops-bot: Reminder set — upload job template created: `upload_to_gcs --src /zoom/recordings --dest gs://marketing/events/launchpad-2026 --notify @Dana R` 

Ana M: Can we also auto-split recording into clips for social? Maybe use ffmpeg segments + markers? Mason, any markers from speakers? 

Mason L: We can use Zoom's timeline to export clips, but better to mark manually during session via chat commands. I'll add a producer cue: when we hit demo segments, type `/clip` in the producer chat. 

Chris P: On confirmation email: include CTA to request a sales demo — map that to HubSpot lifecycle stage = 'marketing_qualified'. Dana please map. 

Dana R: Will do. Also add UTM params for every registration link: ?utm_source=email&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launchpad_2026 

Ana M: Final ask: captions owner, can someone run quick test recording today, upload SRT flow, and confirm playback in Vimeo? 

Mason L: I'll run test at 15:00 PT, post results here. 

Dana R: I'll verify HubSpot mapping after test. 

Chris P: I'll finalize copy by 17:00. 

Ana M: Thanks team :heart: — sync 10:00 tomorrow for final preflight.
